name: cartesian-chart
title: Cartesian chart
description: The shared frame behind the area, line and bar charts: scales, axes, the hover readout, the legend and an accessible data table.

name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: One or more series drawn as a crisp line over a dithered fill that is densest under the line.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Vertical bars, grouped or stacked, each filled with a dither and capped with a solid edge.
